analysis: This batch changes documentation only, and no security regression was identified. The change map is complete. docs/architecture/inference.md head line 1163 now says a bf16 gpt_oss checkpoint keeps bf16 activations and native K/V on every layer, citing the GPTOSS+Experts.swift swiglu implementation. docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md line 689 revises the gpt-oss-20b SSD checkpoint size table from float32 K/V on 23 of 24 layers to bf16 K/V on all 24 layers, which halves per-token bytes and file size. No code, gate, TTL, HMAC name derivation, DBK3 AAD, cacheSalt scoping or kill-switch semantics (T-041) is changed in the supplied units. The smaller files only affect the disk-budget and endurance math; the at-rest exposure stays the same in kind. The surrounding text at lines 808-1586 is unchanged context covering MTP upgrade drain, sampling, MiMo, Qwen4 and Bonsai, and was examined. The implied runtime dtype change, if it is in another batch's code, could alter observed-dtype gates for paged and SSD checkpoint compatibility (PagedKVWriteValidation, layoutEpoch bindings). Integration should confirm that any such code change preserves fail-closed dtype and identity checks for persisted checkpoints. This docs batch provides no such evidence.
